as_of_content:
'''Armor Break''' is a debuff that amplifies damage from attacks and removes or converts existing [[Armor]] Buffs on the opponent. Does not affect Resistance.

== Bots ==
* [[Bumblebee]] - Special 1
* [[Dinobot]] - Blocked Dashes, Special 1
* [[Megatron]] (G1) - Special 1, can be permanently fused
* [[Megatronus]] - Special 1
* [[Motormaster]] - random chance from Heavy Attacks and Special 3
* [[Optimus Prime]] - All Specials, permanent on Special 3
* [[Starscream]] - Special 2
* Tactician [[Sharkticon]] - Signature Special 2
* [[Ultra Magnus]] - All Specials, Special 1 applies one stack regardless of Armor

== Mods ==
* Utility Mode: Stagger

== Strategy ==

=== Strong match-ups ===
* Utility Mod: Armor
* Utility Mod: Armor Timed 
* [[Security Module]]

==== Weak match-ups ====
* [[Exo-Filter]]
